studies.title: Triangulation
studies.caption: Willebrord Snellius measures a long distance by a chain of triangles from one measured baseline.
studies.prompt: Broad low countryside view in the Netherlands1615, two surveyors measuring a straight baseline with a long chain, simple early angle-measuring instrument in foreground, church spires in distance as sighting points. No modern total station, no laser or fluorescent vests.
